description: AI-tailor a resume for a specific job posting. Rewrites content to match the job description and returns a PDF. Provide either jobDescription or jobUrl.

includeCoverLetter.description: Also generate a matching cover letter (returns ZIP with both PDFs)

jobDescription.description: Full job description text to tailor against

jobUrl.description: URL to the job posting (alternative to jobDescription)

language.description: Output language code (e.g. en, de, fr)

mode.description: Tailoring mode: standard modifies existing, new creates from scratch

positionName.description: Job title or position name being applied for

resumeId.description: Resume UUID to tailor (uses user's default resume if omitted)

name: laddro.resumes.tailor
